decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-309 MODIFY capturing the changed 20–40 cm cable length. The optional 44Ω series-resistor policy applies to the separate main-board conditioning requirement and does not supersede the candidate's retained 0Ω power-board resistors.
The SDA/SCL series-resistor policy does not change the standalone USB power source, activation condition, LDO capacity, or powered scope.
The I2C signal-conditioning decision does not alter the power-source OR-ing topology, diodes, sources, or source-selection behavior.
The source concerns SDA/SCL series resistance and does not change addressable-LED voltage, switching, or logic-level handling.
The source does not reassign any ESP32 GPIO; it only makes the 44Ω SDA/SCL series resistors optional according to layout conditions.
The charge-status connector, resistor values, population settings, and indicator behavior are unrelated to the main-board I2C series resistors.
The decision does not change the interboard connector architecture, pinout, physical numbering, or matching-order policy.
The SDA/SCL signal-conditioning choice does not affect the switched 5V boost enable, pull-down, output current, or powered loads.
The source does not modify the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology, net labeling, or reference-design conformance.
The I2C resistor decision does not change the LED-board count, type, or array design.
Allowing removal of main-board I2C resistors when they complicate layout does not change the power board's eight-layer stack.
The reference to layout concerns optional placement of main-board SDA/SCL resistors and does not change the power board's enclosure fit, dimensions, holes, or connector arrangement.
